name: Loxia AI – Intelligent Voice & Chat AI for WordPress & WooCommerce
author: loxiaai

sections.description:
Transform your WordPress site and WooCommerce store into an intelligent, voice-first shopping experience with Loxia AI.

Loxia AI delivers ultra-low-latency (<300ms) conversational AI voice agents, WhatsApp integration, and autonomous live chat designed to boost conversions, reduce support ticket volume by up to 60%, and delight shoppers 24/7.

🌟 Key Features

  • Voice Product Search & Catalog Discovery: Allow shoppers to speak naturally (“Find running shoes size 10 in black under $150”) and receive instant, personalized AI product recommendations directly from your WooCommerce catalog.
  • Hands-Free Voice Order Tracking: Customers can verbally ask “Where is my order #1234?” and receive real-time shipping status and carrier delivery ETAs instantly.
  • Ultra-Low Latency Voice (<300ms): Human-grade conversation speed powered by enterprise-grade speech models. No awkward delays or robotic pauses.
  • 24/7 Autonomous AI Chatbot: Handles customer inquiries, FAQs, return policies, size recommendations, and appointment bookings automatically.
  • Omnichannel WhatsApp & Web Continuity: Seamlessly connect your web widget with WhatsApp Business for abandoned cart recovery and automated post-purchase follow-ups.
  • Multi-Language Auto-Detection (13+ Languages): Compatible with WPML, Polylang, and native WordPress locales. Automatically speaks and chats in English, Italian, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, and more.
  • Zero-Code Setup (30 Seconds): Simply paste your Loxia Agent ID in the admin settings to launch your assistant immediately.
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) Ready: Fully compatible with WooCommerce 8.2+ HPOS and modern custom order tables.

🚀 Why Choose Loxia AI?

  1. Higher Conversion Rates: Shoppers who engage with conversational voice & chat convert up to 4x faster than traditional search-and-filter browsing.
  2. Reduced Support Costs: Deflect routine customer inquiries (shipping times, inventory availability, order status) without expanding your support staff.
  3. Accessibility & Voice-First Shopping: Provide an intuitive, hands-free shopping experience for mobile users, elderly customers, and voice-first shoppers.

    External Services

    This plugin connects to the Loxia AI cloud platform (https://loxiaai.com) to provide conversational voice and chat AI capabilities.

What is Loxia AI?
Loxia AI is a third-party conversational AI SaaS platform that processes natural language voice queries, powers real-time speech synthesis, and coordinates conversational customer support.

What data is transmitted and when:

  1. Plugin Configuration (https://loxiaai.com/api/wordpress/connect): When saving settings in wp-admin, your site domain and widget identifiers are sent to associate your WordPress site with your Loxia account.
  2. Widget Asset Loading (https://loxiaai.com/widget.js): The lightweight widget script is loaded asynchronously on public pages. Visitor messages and voice streams are processed securely through Loxia AI infrastructure.
  3. WooCommerce Context: If WooCommerce is active, contextual page metadata (current product ID, SKU, cart item count, order query) is securely transmitted to deliver accurate, context-aware AI recommendations.

Service Links:
* Terms of Service: https://loxiaai.com/en/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://loxiaai.com/en/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install directly through the WordPress Plugins screen by searching for Loxia AI, or upload the plugin zip file to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Loxia AI in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your Agent ID (available in your Loxia AI Dashboard).
  5. Click Save Settings – your autonomous voice & chat assistant is now active!
sections.faq:
Do I need a Loxia AI account?

Yes. You can create a free trial account at loxiaai.com to get your Agent ID in seconds.

Does this plugin work without WooCommerce?

Yes! If WooCommerce is not active, Loxia AI functions in standard WordPress mode to answer general customer questions, qualify leads, and handle appointment bookings.

How does voice product search work?

Loxia AI securely connects to your active WooCommerce product catalog. When a visitor speaks, the AI understands conversational intent, checks product availability, filters attributes (size, color, category, price), and displays matching items with an instant “Add to Cart” option.

Is it compatible with WPML, Polylang, and multilingual sites?

Yes. The plugin automatically detects the visitor’s active language and switches the voice and chat model dynamically.

What are the performance and speed impacts?

Zero impact on page load speed. The Loxia AI widget loads asynchronously without blocking DOM rendering or affecting Core Web Vitals.
